path = "data_small/"
def FeatureExtractor(path, n_mels, fmax=20000, fmin=20):

    data = []
    max_harm_length = 0 # i will keep track of max harmonic length for naming columns
    
    for dirname, _, filenames in os.walk(path):
        for filename in filenames:
            foldername = os.path.basename(dirname)
            full_path = os.path.join(dirname, filename)
            
            y, sr = librosa.load(full_path)
            mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(y=y, sr=sr, n_mels=n_mels, fmax=fmax, fmin=fmin)
            logam = librosa.power_to_db(mel)            
            data.append(logam)
            
            max_harm_length = max(max_harm_length, logam.shape[1])  # fix First step: Track longest frame length
            
    # fix: Second step: Pad all spectrograms to max_frames
    data = [librosa.util.fix_length(mel, size=max_harm_length, axis=1) for mel in data]
    
    data = np.array(data)        
    return data

path = "data_small/"
def FeatureExtractor(path, n_mels, fmax=20000, fmin=20, fixed_frames=128):

    data = []

    for dirname, _, filenames in os.walk(path):
        for filename in filenames:
            full_path = os.path.join(dirname, filename)

            y, sr = librosa.load(full_path)
            mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(y=y, sr=sr, n_mels=n_mels, fmax=fmax, fmin=fmin)
            logam = librosa.power_to_db(mel)

            # Ensure all samples have the same time dimension before stacking
            if logam.shape[1] < fixed_frames:
                pad_width = fixed_frames - logam.shape[1]
                logam = np.pad(logam, ((0, 0), (0, pad_width)), mode='constant')
            else:
                logam = logam[:, :fixed_frames]

            data.append(logam)

    data = np.array(data)
    return data

path = "data_small/"
def FeatureExtractor(path, n_mels, fmax=20000, fmin=20):

    data = []

    for dirname, _, filenames in os.walk(path):
        for filename in filenames:
            full_path = os.path.join(dirname, filename)

            # Skip non-audio/system files
            if not os.path.isfile(full_path):
                continue

            try:
                y, sr = librosa.load(full_path, sr=None)
                mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(y=y, sr=sr, n_mels=n_mels, fmax=fmax, fmin=fmin)
                logam = librosa.power_to_db(mel)
                # Aggregate to fixed-length feature vector so np.array works reliably
                feat = np.mean(logam, axis=1)
                data.append(feat)
            except Exception:
                # Ignore unreadable/non-audio files
                continue

    data = np.array(data)
    return data
